news.headline: UK to announce trade ban on West Bank settlement goods
news.body: Britain will announce a trade ban on goods made in Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, a senior minister said on Tuesday as part of efforts to support a two‑state solution. The policy change will be set out in a Commons statement and could alter trade relations with Israeli businesses tied to the settlements.
